title: Pro Shop Store Credit: dormancy, expiration and low-balance alert terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's dormancy and expiration facet across every tier: the days of account inactivity after which the balance begins to expire, the days with no redemption or top-up activity before the account is considered dormant, the monthly fee charged against a dormant balance, the days of dormancy before that fee begins, and the balance level below which a low-balance alert is sent.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Expiration window | Inactivity period before dormancy | Monthly dormancy fee | Dormancy grace period before the fee begins | Low-balance alert level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | 365 days | 180 days | 0 USD | 180 days | 10.00 USD |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | 365 days | 180 days | 0 USD | 180 days | 15.00 USD |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | 365 days | 270 days | 0 USD | 270 days | 25.00 USD |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | 730 days | 365 days | 0 USD | 365 days | 50.00 USD |
| Auto-Reload Standard | 365 days | 180 days | 0 USD | 180 days | 15.00 USD |
| Auto-Reload Premium | 730 days | 270 days | 0 USD | 270 days | 30.00 USD |

## Points of reference
- The inactivity period before dormancy is the figure the account's own expiration basis reads to determine when a balance begins to be forfeited for inactivity; a separate document states that basis's full anchor, comparison and handling terms.
- No tier currently charges a positive monthly dormancy fee, so the dormancy grace period currently has no fee to begin.
- The low-balance alert level is the balance point below which the account is sent an alert that its spendable balance is running low.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tier allows the longest run of inactivity before dormancy?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier and Auto-Reload Premium's underlying expiration window both run to 730 days, longer than the 365-day window on the remaining tiers.
**Is the low-balance alert level the same across every tier?** No — it scales with the tier's typical balance, from 10.00 USD on the Starter Credit $50 Tier up to 50.00 USD on the VIP Credit $500 Tier.
